gbifID.description: Unique global biodiversity information facility record identifier for each occurrence.

datasetKey.description: Unique identifier linking each occurrence record to its GBIF dataset.

occurrenceID.description: Unique observation URL linking to iNaturalist record for each Antennaria racemosa occurrence.

kingdom.description: Taxonomic kingdom classification, always Plantae for these records.

phylum.description: Phylum of the organism, consistently Tracheophyta for all records.

class.description: Taxonomic class of the plant, consistently Magnoliopsida for all records.

order.description: Taxonomic order of the record, consistently Asterales.

family.description: Family classification for all records, consistently Asteraceae.

genus.description: Genus of the recorded plant, consistently Antennaria.

species.description: Scientific name of the recorded plant, consistently Antennaria racemosa.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Infraspecific epithet data is entirely missing across all records.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of the record, always SPECIES.

scientificName.description: Taxonomic designation of the recorded Antennaria racemosa specimen.

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name of the species recorded, consistently Antennaria racemosa.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Scientific name authorship information, as originally recorded, is missing for all records.

countryCode.description: Two-letter ISO code identifying the nation where each occurrence was recorded.

locality.description: Locality data is missing for all records.

stateProvince.description: Administrative region of occurrence, such as provinces or states in western North America.

occurrenceStatus.description: All records denote presence of the species at each occurrence location.

individualCount.description: Number of individual organisms recorded for each occurrence.

publishingOrgKey.description: Uniform UUID identifying the organization that published each occurrence record.

decimalLatitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees for each occurrence record.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees for each occurrence record.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Spatial uncertainty of occurrence coordinates measured in meters.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision data missing for all records.

elevation.description: Elevation data is missing for all records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Measurement of elevation precision is unavailable

depth.description: Depth field is missing for all records.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth accuracy data is missing for all records.

eventDate.description: Observation timestamp of each occurrence record, recorded in ISO 8601 date‑time format.

day.description: Day of month when the observation was recorded.

year.description: Calendar year when the occurrence was recorded.

taxonKey.description: Uniform taxonomic identifier for Antennaria racemosa occurrence records.

speciesKey.description: Species identifier for Antennaria racemosa, constant across all occurrence records.

basisOfRecord.description: All records are derived from human observations of Antennaria racemosa occurrences.

institutionCode.description: Data source identifier, consistently iNaturalist for all records.

collectionCode.description: All records are from the “Observations” collection.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier for each occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: No data recorded for this field.

identifiedBy.description: Names of individuals who recorded or identified each Antennaria racemosa occurrence.

license.description: License type for each occurrence record, using Creative Commons designations.

rightsHolder.description: Names of individuals or organizations holding usage rights for each record.

recordedBy.description: Names of individuals who recorded each occurrence.

typeStatus.description: type status information is missing for all records.

establishmentMeans.description: Establishment means data missing for all records.

lastInterpreted.description: Last interpretation date and time of the occurrence record.

mediaType.description: Media type of occurrence record, indicating image format such as still photographs.

issue.description: List of data quality flags such as coordinate rounding and missing taxon identifiers.

antennaria_racemosa.description: GBIF occurrence records of Antennaria racemosa with taxonomic, geographic, temporal, and observer metadata.
